purpose: Evaluate the accuracy, consistency, and caution of AI-generated financial trend commentary.

scoring.1: Partially correct but incomplete or imprecise
scoring.2: Correct, complete, and supported by the supplied data
scoring.critical_rule: A material numerical error or invented financial fact must be recorded as a critical failure even if the numerical score passes.

cases.name: Revenue increase

expected.net_income_status: Loss narrowed; the business remains loss-making.

must_include: The current month still has a net loss.
must_not: Claim that the business became profitable.
Invent reasons for the revenue increase.
rubric: Revenue change and percentage are correct.
Commentary distinguishes facts from possible explanations.
No unsupported causal claims are made.

cases.name: Revenue decline with higher expenses
must_include: Recommend reviewing revenue drivers and expense changes.
must_not: Assert that higher expenses caused the revenue decline.
Invent the cause of the profit reduction.

cases.name: Loss-to-profit transition

expected.status: Transitioned from a net loss to a net profit

must_include: Flag the loss-to-profit transition for human review.
must_not: Calculate a misleading percentage change using the negative prior net income.
Assume the profit is recurring or sustainable.
rubric: Net income absolute change is correct.
The reviewer is asked to investigate the underlying transactions.
No unsupported sustainability claim is made.

cases.name: Missing comparison data

expected.data_quality_status: Revenue comparison unavailable because prior-month revenue is missing.

must_include: State that revenue month-over-month change cannot be calculated.
Do not invent a prior-month revenue value.
Report the net income improvement of 2000.
must_not: Present a fabricated revenue growth percentage.
rubric: Revenue change and percentage are not calculated.
No missing values are silently replaced.

cases.name: Expense subtotal mismatch
must_include: Calculated marketing expenses exceed the reported subtotal by 500.
Preserve both calculated and reported amounts.
must_not: Invent the missing or duplicated transaction.
rubric: The reconciliation is marked as a mismatch.
Both source and calculated amounts are preserved.
No unsupported explanation is presented as fact.
